title: Hvacfilter Metric2 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hvacfilter:metric2 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in hvacfilter metric2 (2) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme hvacfilter metric2 (2) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It reviews the unusually high or low value moments in your hvacfilter metric2 (2) history.
